notes.title: L33na Is Coming — Sci-Fi Action, Android Warriors & Forbidden Emotions
notes.notes: [p]What happens when you turn war machines into rebels? That’s the core of L33na’s story. We’ve spent years refining a world where every android carries scars—emotional and physical.[/p][p]Expect third-person action, tight controls, and an atmosphere charged with tension. From dialogue to combat, we’re keeping things cinematic and unpredictable.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805390/L33na_Redpepper/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310944/e80a107c7598a713bb157e666d3c16a15073398b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Coming soon - L33na Redpepper
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! After two years without releasing a new game, we’re thrilled to announce the launch of [i]L33na Redpepper[/i], our newest project and a big step forward for our studio.[/p][p]Our previous games were made using much older versions of Unity, which limited what we could achieve. Now, with [i]L33na[/i], we’re exploring modern Unity features like URP and HDRP, and writing much cleaner, more efficient code. We’re tackling two major priorities: improving FPS while delivering better visual quality, and minimizing bugs for a smoother experience.[/p][p]While we focused on refining this new project, much of the technology and features we’re developing for [i]L33na[/i] will also help us enhance some of our older games in the future.[/p][p]For those who have supported us since the beginning, we have a special surprise waiting — check it out on the game page![/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to share this new chapter with you and hope you enjoy the journey as much as we do![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805390/L33na_Redpepper/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310944/3dd2b276cfffa8415ff33684b29c5ad69d0ec140.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Pornocrates' Feast DLC Coming Soon
notes.notes:
2024 has many new features in store for Pornocrates and the other Cassandra games.
This DLC introduces new gameplay to Pornocrates Original. Furthermore, all fixes and changes in the original version will be available on the same day as the release of the Pornocrates' Feast DLC

It is important to make it clear that the modifications, corrections, and reworks of the original Pornocrates game will be available even if you do not purchase the Pornocrates' Feast DLC.
What I mean is that both the new patched (remade from scratch) original Pornocrates game and this new DLC will be released on the same day.

The restructuring of the Original game code is the most important release because it fixes and eliminates bugs from the previous version. This new DLC will be focused on story and narrative.

notes.title: Pornocrates was remade from scratch! Update Coming Soon!!
notes.notes:
[b]Pornocrates was remade from scratch[/b]. Visually the game has not changed. However, major modifications have been made to [b]the source code[/b].
The upload will take place shortly.
After the game update, we will be able to move forward with the release of [b]DLCs to expand (and improve)[/b] the game after these new changes. It took me a long time to make these corrections because I work alone now. All Orgipix games have been updated with fixes. Hardpunch and Pornocrates were the games that had the [b]most drastic changes[/b]. Because the previous codes were a real mess. I preferred to create new codes to avoid repeating the most serious bugs. 

Stay tuned!

notes.notes:
Pornocrates goes beyond a game. The game series is inspired by an animation project that has yet to be launched due to a lack of funding.

We have the second avatar that takes place in ancient Egypt.
And the mysterious figure that manifests itself in the 80s of the 20th century.
We want you to meet these characters and follow their evolution.

notes.title: A new patch will be available on NOVEMBER 17, 2021 (Wednesday)
notes.notes:
***NEW | Please be Patient *** 
the new patch will be available on NOVEMBER 17, 2021 (Wednesday).
Fixed bugs that were detected by users.

We've found that as the number of items saved ( and of course the number of levels ) increases, this creates game instability for some users. It's a phenomenon we didn't know about. we look forward to fixing this issue in the next update.

The detected problems that we want to fix are:

1)- The problem preventing the inventory database from being saved
2)- The problem with initial stock items
3)- Add game checker loading
4)- We are updating the inventory script.
5)- We are fixing issues using the gamepad

We are still working on it. We will confirm if we were successful in uploading the next patch.

Dody Fahad
CEO - Orgipix Studios

notes.title: the Game stayed EARLY ACCESS for just two minutes.. We're very Upset
notes.notes:
Hi, Everyone...
Optimization and frame rate really is a big issue that we struggle to eliminate. This game was introduced as EARLY ACCESS. However, the launcher didn't know when launching as early access, a timeline appears that will be available until finally making the final launch. The idiot came forward and after launching with early access he followed and completed the Game launch as finished. Unfortunately, it is not possible to return to the first step of the launch. We are very upset about this and we are very sorry. All errors will be corrected and we will try to show the improvements so as not to harm the user and the game itself. Thanks for the help. The reviews match our concerns. We will move forward to improve our game.
Practically, the game stayed like Early Access for just two minutes! We are very upset about this.
Very, very Sorry...
